hotel_name: Four Seasons Bangkok at Chao Phraya River

claims.text: The hotel opened in December 2020.

findings.quote: December 2020

claims.text: The hotel has 299 guest rooms and suites.

findings.quote: 299 spacious guest rooms and suites

claims.text: The hotel is on the Chao Phraya River in the Charoen Krung Road area.

findings.quote: Located along the Chao Phraya River offering stunning views and a tranquil retreat in the heart of the dynamic Charoen Krung Road area.
findings.note: River and Charoen Krung Road area

claims.text: The hotel has two outdoor riverfront infinity pools.

findings.quote: Two temperature-controlled outdoor infinity pools with sweeping Chao Phraya River views

claims.text: Interior designer Jean-Michel Gathy designed the hotel's interiors.

findings.quote: **Interior Designer:** Jean-Michel Gathy (DENNISTON)

claims.text: A complimentary shuttle boat runs between the hotel, BTS Saphan Taksin and ICONSIAM Shopping Centre.

findings.quote: Complimentary shuttle boat services are available between BTS Saphan Taksin, ICONSIAM Shopping Centre and our Hotel.

claims.text: The nearest BTS Skytrain station is Saphan Taksin, a 15-minute walk from the hotel.

findings.quote: The nearest BTS Skytrain station is Saphan Taksin (Exit 4), a 15-minute walk from our Hotel.

claims.text: The hotel is a 40-minute drive from Suvarnabhumi International Airport.

findings.quote: just a 40-minute drive from Suvarnabhumi International Airport

claims.text: Yu Ting Yuan serves authentic Cantonese cuisine.

findings.quote: The signature Yu Ting Yuan (御庭院) serves authentic Cantonese cuisine in a dramatic ambiance.

claims.text: BKK Social Club is a cocktail bar at the hotel.

findings.quote: BKK Social Club is an award-winning destination cocktail bar in Bangkok
findings.note: Cocktail bar listed among hotel dining

claims.text: The hotel offers 24-hour in-room dining.

findings.quote: our extensive 24-hour In-Room Dining menu

claims.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and high ceilings.

findings.quote: each featuring high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows that create a bright, airy atmosphere

claims.text: The Premier River-View Room looks out over the Chao Phraya River.

findings.quote: Savour wide-open riverscapes from the quiet comfort of your luxurious guest room. Watch the Chao Phraya wake up in the morning light
findings.note: Premier River-View Room overlooks the river

claims.text: Riva del Fiume serves Italian dishes on the Chao Phraya River.

findings.quote: Riva del Fiume is an authentic Italian restaurant in Bangkok offering handmade pasta and wood-fired Neapolitan pizza on the Chao Phraya River.

claims.text: Chao Phraya Terrace is a farm-to-table Thai charcoal grill restaurant.

findings.quote: Thai farm-to-table charcoal grill Chao Phraya Terrace

claims.text: The Urban Wellness Centre includes a spa and a fitness centre with a lap pool.

findings.quote: Swim in two temperature-controlled infinity pools or begin your morning at our 35-metre (115-foot) lap pool. At the Urban Wellness Centre, cutting-edge fitness, spa and holistic therapies
findings.note: Wellness centre with fitness, spa, and lap pool

claims.text: Riva del Fiume is closed for the season, reopening October 27, 2026.
